C-SAFE-DELIVERY.Name: Safe sequential desktop integration and independent mobile delivery
C-SAFE-DELIVERY.Summary: Preserve local work, require deterministic and two-pass local-model safety review before every commit and push, and integrate the owner's accepted desktop tasks one at a time while mobile follows an independent branch and delivery cadence.
C-SAFE-DELIVERY.ApprovalBasis: The owner explicitly approved preservation and desktop steps 1-3, required a separate merge after each task, deferred step 4 for discussion, required independent mobile commits/releases, and required a secrets/paths safety protocol with mandatory local-model review and recheck before every commit and push on 2026-10-19. This bundle implements that directive without authorizing publication or broad GRACE cleanup.

Goals.Goal: Protect recoverable commits and dirty layers without publishing private backups.
Enforce exact-candidate secret/path/artifact scans, serial local-model review and skeptical recheck, and candidate identity validation in shared worktree hooks.
Document desktop/mobile independence and integrate accepted desktop fixes as separately verified commits.

Constraints.Constraint: No hook bypass, cloud fallback, parallel inference engines or raw sensitive console output.
Keep unrelated store and mobile WIP out of desktop commits; no tags, version bumps, uploads or release publication.
Preserve existing GRACE 3 provenance and unrelated approved plans; broad lifecycle reconciliation remains deferred.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No new product feature, blanket refactor, global coverage target, store submission or mobile runtime rewrite.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Common hooks block detected secrets, personal paths, unsupported binary/generated material, missing tools/models, malformed model results and changed candidates.
Every commit and push gets two serial local-model passes over its complete bounded chunks and an independent final diff inspection.
Meaningful deterministic gate tests pass and GRACE projections own the new tool.
Desktop integration and mobile preservation/protocol are separate changes and no release is triggered.

AffectedAreas.Area: tools/security_gate.py, tests/security, docs/commit-push-safety.md, AGENTS.md, package scripts and additive M-064/V-M-064 projections.
Private common Git hooks/evidence and recovery storage; mobile branch protocol and subsequent scoped desktop integration.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Redacted deterministic findings, two serial local-model pass records and exact candidate hashes, with no private payload committed.
